status: Captured and rendered; both product editions passed full decoding and frame/stream/caption checks.

ko.narration: New Korean script; Harry Kim — Conversational, ElevenLabs Eleven v4, Generation 1

en.narration: New English script; Daniel — Radio news host, ElevenLabs Eleven v4, Generation 1

visitor_scope: new independent Playwright context; own visitor only; no existing user cookies or records

styles.motion: actual Three.js, English labels shared by both versions
styles.captions: maximum two lines, measured glyph bounds and at least 44px bottom margin

archive_policy: Preserve existing culture-fit-demo-1080p.mp4, culture-fit-demo-en-1080p.mp4 and their source/verification artifacts. New deliverables use culture-fit-product-* names.
capture_rules: Use actual deployed English UI without text substitution or a fabricated language selector.
Obtain final deploy-ready signal before recording.
Only mutate the fresh recording visitor. Do not call new model analysis, live mode or external integrations.
Use prepared synthetic example and saved model analysis.
Approvals are operator-entered records, not independent remote-owner authentication.
Actual Windows guide/PowerShell commands may be shown; do not claim Windows hardware execution.
If terminal startup is included, use the downloaded source in a video-owned isolated directory and separate port, with a separate DB. Never start the shared working tree on 8787.
UI state changes must match the narration; never substitute an illustrative animation for proof of a performed app action.
First-run empty local workspace must be visibly distinguished from the public seeded demo; use separate labels and actual URL navigation.

installation_evidence.os_support: OS-specific launch scripts in a common source archive; not native app binaries
installation_evidence.windows: script and instructions supplied; no physical Windows run verified
installation_evidence.openclaw: Skill discovery/configuration verified in existing project evidence; no claim of a live model using it

speech.ko: 같은 정보를 아는 두 에이전트. 그렇다고 승인 권한까지 같을까요?
speech.en: Two agents can share the same information. But does that mean they have the same authority?

cues.required_screen: Three.js: two agents share an information node; separate owner-to-agent authority links. No project history.

speech.ko: 서로 다른 사람에게 위임받았다면, 중요한 결정 앞에서 누구의 뜻을 따라야 할지 정해야 해요.
speech.en: When different people delegate authority, the agents need to know whose approval a decision requires.

cues.required_screen: Three.js: overlapping approve scope, unresolved decision; show question Who can decide?

speech.ko: 컬처핏은 근거와 권한을 살피고, 필요한 순간에 사람의 판단을 연결하는 오픈소스 휴먼 인 더 루프 계층이에요.
speech.en: Culture-Fit is an open-source Human-in-the-Loop layer. It connects evidence, delegated authority, and human judgment when a decision needs it.

cues.required_screen: Actual English landing hero, then product name and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL).

speech.ko: 웹에서 바로 체험하거나, 소스를 내려받아 자신의 환경에서 시작할 수 있어요.
speech.en: Try it in your browser, or download the source and run it in your own environment.

cues.required_screen: Landing page: Try the demo and Install locally. Follow Install locally to /download.

speech.ko: 소스 ZIP을 받고 압축을 풀어 주세요. 파이썬 실행 환경은 유브이로 준비해요.
speech.en: Download and extract the source ZIP. Use uv to prepare the Python environment.

cues.required_screen: Actual source ZIP download to video-owned folder; show Python 3.11+ and official uv guide link. No fabricated terminal execution.

speech.ko: 설치 안내에서 운영체제를 고르고, 맥은 셸 스크립트, 윈도우는 파워셸 명령을 실행하면 돼요.
speech.en: Choose your operating system in the setup guide. On Mac, use the shell script. On Windows, use the PowerShell command.

cues.required_screen: Actual macOS and Windows tabs and visible commands; retain Windows hardware-validation note. These are source launch scripts, not native installers.

speech.ko: 오픈클로를 쓴다면 스킬 ZIP을 받아, 실행 중인 컬처핏 서버에 연결할 수도 있어요.
speech.en: If you use OpenClaw, download the Skill ZIP and configure it to connect to your running Culture-Fit server.

cues.required_screen: Actual Skill ZIP card, then Skill setup section showing extraDirs and local API. Do not show automatic connection or model execution.

speech.ko: 화면은 영어로 제공하고, 대화 분석은 한국어와 영어를 지원해요.
speech.en: The interface is in English. Conversation analysis supports both English and Korean.

cues.required_screen: Actual first-run empty workspace from downloaded source ZIP, isolated video-owned folder/DB and separate port. Show English interface; use truthful editorial label English interface · English & Korean conversation analysis. No language toggle.

speech.ko: 첫 화면에서 대화를 가져오거나, 준비된 예제로 결정이 필요한 상황을 살펴볼 수 있어요.
speech.en: From the workspace, import a conversation or explore a prepared example that needs a decision.

cues.required_screen: Visibly switch from Local installation to Public demo using actual public site navigation. Show English workspace Import conversation control/dialog, close and show prepared visitor-specific sample. Label Synthetic example / Recorded analysis.

speech.ko: 이 예제에선 릴리스 에이전트와 리뷰 에이전트가 같은 배포의 승인 권한을 가지고 있어요.
speech.en: Here, Release Agent and Review Agent both have approval grants for the same release.

cues.required_screen: Overview authority card shows payment-release-1.2 / approve and both eligible agents.

speech.ko: 하지만 위임한 소유자는 서로 달라요. 아직 누가 결정할지는 정해지지 않았죠.
speech.en: Their grants come from different owners. The decision owner is still unknown.

cues.required_screen: Knowledge scoped-authority table then Overview conflict card: Owner A/B, Decision owner Unknown.

speech.ko: 브리핑은 합의된 내용과 남은 질문, 사람의 판단이 필요한 지점을 모아 보여줘요.
speech.en: The decision brief brings together agreements, open questions, and points that need human judgment.

cues.required_screen: Actual saved Decision brief sections. Small label Recorded model analysis; no live model request.

speech.ko: 근거를 누르면 원문으로 이어져요. 요약만 보고 결정하지 않도록 발언을 함께 확인하죠.
speech.en: Select a source reference to read the original message, and check what was actually said.

cues.required_screen: Click actual m1/m2 source chip to Conversation and show English transcript. This is a translated replay already present in the public fixture.

speech.ko: 이제 리뷰 에이전트를 우선으로 두는 순서를 정해볼게요.
speech.en: Now, put Review Agent first in the proposed priority order.

cues.required_screen: Actual Review Agent Priority Up click; show reordered list before any approval. Small label Operator-entered approvals.

speech.ko: 한 사람의 동의만 기록하면, 다른 소유자의 승인이 남아 있어요.
speech.en: With only one owner’s approval recorded, the other owner’s approval is still required.

cues.required_screen: Select Owner A only, submit partial order, verify conflict persists and Owner B remains missing. Only our fresh visitor is changed.

speech.ko: 두 소유자의 동의를 모두 기록하고, 이 결정에 적용할 우선순위를 저장해요.
speech.en: Record both owners’ agreement, then save the priority order for this decision.

cues.required_screen: Select missing Owner B, save priority and approvals; retain exact scope/action. Do not imply two independently authenticated people.

speech.ko: 권한을 다시 확인하면 리뷰 에이전트가 담당자로 나타나요. 누가 진행할 수 있는지 분명해졌죠.
speech.en: After the authority check updates, Review Agent appears as the decision owner. It is clear who can proceed.

cues.required_screen: Actual authorized result, Review Agent decision owner, briefing intervention count updates. No external execution.

speech.ko: 이 판단은 해당 배포의 승인에 적용돼요. 다른 업무의 권한은 그 범위와 행동에 맞춰 따로 확인해요.
speech.en: This decision applies to approval of this release. Other actions are checked against their own scope and authority.

cues.required_screen: Actual payment-release-1.2 / approve scope beside current grants. Do not invent a second successful authority check.

speech.ko: 자신의 환경에서는 엠씨피로 에이전트가 대화를 보고하고, 다음 행동과 권한 상태를 조회할 수 있어요.
speech.en: In your own installation, agents can use MCP to report conversations and query next actions and authority.

cues.required_screen: Public Connections tab → download page actual MCP JSON configuration. Small label Local installation configuration; not a live public MCP connection.

speech.ko: 에이투에이와 스킬 연결도 제공해서, 쓰는 에이전트 환경에 맞게 붙일 수 있어요.
speech.en: A2A and Skill interfaces offer additional ways to connect the agent environments you use.

cues.required_screen: English Three.js product architecture: agent clients → MCP / A2A / Skill → Culture-Fit. Clearly explanatory diagram, not a recorded live agent session.

speech.ko: 컬처핏은 전 세계 개발자가 수정하고 연결할 수 있는 엠아이티 오픈소스예요.
speech.en: Culture-Fit is MIT-licensed open source, built for developers everywhere to adapt and connect.

cues.required_screen: Actual public repository/LICENSE or English Three.js end card with MIT, GitHub, global developer target. No adoption metrics.

speech.ko: 필요한 순간, 필요한 사람에게. 컬처핏에서 직접 확인해 보세요.
speech.en: The right person, at the right moment. Try Culture-Fit for yourself.

cues.required_screen: English Three.js end card: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL), public demo URL and source URL; quiet source and ElevenLabs credit.
